rows.label: bf07470100_0005
rows.name: What is it? Did you remember something?

rows.label: bf07470100_0020
rows.name:
Then there's 'that' on the Marsanes
that Satahiko is adjusting...

rows.label: bf07470100_0030
rows.name: Once we link with it, everything will be complete.

rows.label: bf07470100_0050
rows.name:
That thing is not a Holy Grail anymore.
It is just...a lump of flesh.
